#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from PBS

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# PBS resources:
#   -q windfall
#   -l select=1:ncpus=28:mem=168gb:pcmem=6gb:ngpus=1:os7=True
#   -W group_list=msurdeanu
#   -l walltime=48:00:00
#   -j oe

#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 28
#flux: --time-limit=48h

# Omitted PBS option: -q windfall (queue)
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may not run on the intended windfall/backfill resources, affecting start time/priority.

# Omitted PBS option: -W group_list=msurdeanu
# Flux accounting/project/group controls are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may be charged to a default project/account or be rejected by policy.

# Omitted PBS option: mem=168gb and pcmem=6gb
# Flux memory requests are site/config dependent and not universally portable.
# Performance implication: job may be scheduled on a node with insufficient memory, risking OOM kills or heavy swapping.

# Omitted PBS option: ngpus=1
# Flux GPU requests are site/config dependent (often via custom resource types).
# Performance implication: job may start without a GPU, causing failure or severe slowdown.

# Omitted PBS option: os7=True
# Node OS constraints are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may land on nodes with a different OS/software stack, potentially causing module/runtime incompatibilities.

# Omitted PBS option: -j oe (join stdout/stderr)
# Flux commonly manages stdout/stderr separately; a portable join directive is not guaranteed.
# Performance implication: logs may be split across stdout/stderr (no runtime performance impact).

cd /xdisk/msurdeanu/mithunpaul/
module load cuda90/neuralnet/7/7.3.1.20
module load python/3.6/3.6.5

# (Re)create venv
rm -rf sandeep_bert_venv
mkdir sandeep_bert_venv
python3 -m venv sandeep_bert_venv

source sandeep_bert_venv/bin/activate

cd /xdisk/msurdeanu/mithunpaul/bert_tensorflow

pip install --upgrade pip
pip install -r requirements.txt

export PYTHONPATH="/home/u11/mithunpaul/sandeep_bert/"

bash run_sandeep_code.sh

reasons: PBS requested 1 GPU (`ngpus=1`) but the Flux resource section does not request any GPUs; on GPU-managed systems this can yield a CPU-only allocation and the job may fail or run much slower.

PBS requested 168GB memory (`mem=168gb`, plus `pcmem=6gb`) but the Flux resource section has no memory request; the job may be scheduled on a node with insufficient memory, risking OOM kills or degraded performance.
issues: The job installs Python packages at runtime (`pip install ...`), which can significantly increase runtime and variability; consider using a pre-built environment or caching wheels if possible.
